craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vīra of sealing — girt-am → nectar-life → eightfold-circle → seals-all → loosed-called → draught-dwells → moment-rises → effortless-all; the treatise seals effortless. Seals-all; path-joyed; showing-full close. Rejected: (a) joyed→joyful → killed: joyed is made-joy. Read aloud: IT-seals-ALL-this … BY-show-ing-FULL.

lines: It seals all this — total self-form given over —
gladdens the devotee-throng, path-joyed, by showing full.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mudrayati nikhilam etan niḥśeṣasvasvarūpasaṃkramaṇāt modayati bhaktavargaṃ gatimudaṃ pūrṇatāprathanāt

reads_against.argmap: What seals all? → Sealing delights throng by fullness-showing.
c1_essence: Sealed all delighted throng by fullness-shown.
Conquering draught dwells clearly; stain known.
In-me flashing sealed; rite complete effortless.
reads_against.c1_rasa: raudra-vīra of ghoul-girt am-I; amṛta-bhakti of heart-shining; adbhuta of eightfold retinue; mudrā-vīra of sealed all; mudrā-vīra of called seal; vīra of conquering draught; adbhuta of momently rising; śānta of sealed rite
